settings.label: First-line systemic: stage III–IV or first recurrence, chemotherapy-naive for advanced disease
Maintenance after response to first-line platinum
Second line and beyond (after platinum ± PD-(L)1)

tiers.1: OS benefit, replicated (≥2 randomised trials or a class effect confirmed by non-inferiority)
tiers.2: OS benefit, single phase 3 (CI excludes 1 as printed), or non-inferior to a regimen that has one
tiers.3: OS benefit only in a subgroup (molecular post hoc, randomised phase II) or borderline
tiers.4: PFS / RFS / local-control benefit only; no OS benefit shown
tiers.5: No efficacy difference vs the comparator (non-inferior / NS), or the comparator that lost: chosen on toxicity or when the better option cannot be given
tiers.6: No phase 3: single-arm, randomised phase II without an OS result, observational, extrapolated, or press release only
tiers.7: Do not use: OS worse than the alternative, negative trial, or histotype excluded from the pivotal trial

_meta.tier_reading: Endometrioid is the majority of every all-histology trial (54–71%), so trial-wide (ITT) results and the prespecified dMMR / pMMR strata set the tier; an MMR stratum, when it disagrees with the ITT, wins for a patient with known MMR. Histology forest plots are shown as qualifiers. PORTEC-3 molecular classes are post hoc: they add fit / caution flags and lift p53abn stage I–II chemoradiation to tier 3, but do not move other tiers.
_meta.scope: Efficacy figures copied from data/trials_*.json (vault notes, full-text checked 2026-09-15); toxicity resolved from data/tox.json via tox_ref {trial, arm}; label rules from data/labels.json and data/drug_rules.json. 'base' inherits every field the record does not set from the named endometrioid record.
